user.title: Set up parental control
user.description: Choose the TVs (media players) and how to confirm. You can change everything later under "Configure".

data.name: Name
data.actionable: Confirm button in the phone notification

data_description.media_players: When one of these TVs is switched on it must be confirmed, otherwise it is switched off again.
data_description.notify_services: Services like mobile_app_patrick. Includes a confirm button when enabled.
data_description.notify_entities: Entities for notify.send_message, e.g. a speech output in the living room.
data_description.confirm_entities: Optional: existing input_boolean or switch entities that can also confirm.
data_description.time_start: Outside the time window nothing is asked. Equal start and end means all day.
data_description.attempt_reset_minutes: If the last failed attempt is older than this, counting starts over.

error.no_media_player: Please select at least one TV.
error.no_weekday: Please select at least one weekday.
